description: Select an option from a <select> dropdown by ref or selector, and option value.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple elements, select from the Nth one (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the <select> element (CSS, text="...", :has-text("..."), role=..., [data-testid="..."]). Fallback when you have no ref. NEVER use :contains().

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

textHint.description: What the dropdown is for, in words (e.g. "Country"). If the selector matches nothing, the server tries an exact role+name match and the visible candidates are ranked against this phrase. Advisory.

name: browser_select
